name: @tui-games/tui
description: Play familiar single-player games in a lightweight HTML overlay while your agents work.

scripts.build:overlay: bun run build:overlay:web && cargo build --release --manifest-path tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.dev:overlay: bun run build:overlay:web && cargo build --manifest-path tauri/Cargo.toml && GAMEPIGEON_OVERLAY_BIN="$PWD/tauri/target/debug/gamepigeon-overlay" bun scripts/overlay.ts --show
scripts.test:adapters: bun run build && bash scripts/install-adapters.test.sh && bash scripts/dev-harness.test.sh
scripts.test:overlay: bun test scripts/overlay.test.ts scripts/antigravity-hook.test.ts scripts/plugin-update.test.ts scripts/arcade-engagement.test.ts scripts/version-bump.test.ts overlay/persistence.test.ts overlay/recording.test.ts overlay/renderers.test.ts overlay/analytics.test.ts overlay/tauri-bridge.test.ts overlay/pause-state.test.ts overlay/auth.test.ts overlay/update.test.ts overlay/restaurant-arena-timeline.test.ts overlay/restaurant-arena-layout.test.ts overlay/restaurant-arena-brief.test.ts overlay/restaurant-arena-repaint-gate.test.ts overlay/restaurant-arena-toast.test.ts overlay/staff-walk.test.ts scripts/export-bc.test.ts
scripts.prepack: bun run build && bun run build:overlay:web
